reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view and Radare2 6.2.0 on retail igi.exe (SHA-256 dea34892...); the candidate translation unit was recompiled with the repository -O3 -DNDEBUG flags and its object symbol compared with the body recorded for the previous source digest.
source_revision: worktree HEAD 5a3b6e40521b2159f6dce7e8ecbeafb8fe3b9b91 plus the uncommitted Qvm_ReportError correction; bound by engine/src/retail/script/qvm_native_loader.cpp sha256 48ae1e2700dfc8738d9ea1a31178495ff821c3bed69ac189263a88eebac8359f
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/script/qvm_native_loader.cpp hashes to 48ae1e2700dfc8738d9ea1a31178495ff821c3bed69ac189263a88eebac8359f. The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja view and independently recovered with Radare2 on 2026-10-23; both live graphs are identical to the bound artifacts, so the recorded CFG is current. The candidate was recompiled from that source; its object symbol body was compared with the body compiled from the previous source digest 655494c9... and is instruction-identical after relocation resolution, proving the Qvm_ReportError edit did not alter this function. This review supersedes the earlier evidence that was stale against the current source digest.

retail_function.name: Resource_FileExists
retail_function.summary: 0x004B5B60-0x004B5B85 (38 bytes), 3 basic blocks / 2 edges, cdecl int32_t(const char* path): calls Is_ResourceLoaded(path, 0) (0x004B5B90); returns 1 when the result is non-zero; otherwise tail-calls Sys_DispatchOpcode_7(path) (0x004B1FC0) and returns its EAX. No stores.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 both recover 0x004B5B60-0x004B5B85 with 3 blocks / 2 edges; the live re-read matches the bound artifacts exactly (similarity 1.000). The candidate symbol igi::retail::script::Resource_FileExists(char const*) is the body implementing that entry, 64 bytes including alignment padding.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail reads the single stack argument once at [esp+8] into ESI and passes it unchanged as the first argument of both callees; the candidate declares const char* path and passes it unchanged. cdecl with caller-cleaned stack (add esp,8 and add esp,4) and a 32-bit int return are preserved.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The immediate 0 is the second Is_ResourceLoaded argument and the immediate 1 is the loaded-path return value; both are present at the same points in the candidate. No scaling or arithmetic.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Call sites, order and arguments match retail: Is_ResourceLoaded(path, 0) first, then Sys_DispatchOpcode_7(path) only on the not-loaded path; no stores. The second callee (0x004B1FC0) is not yet transcribed and is invoked through the injectable g_sys_dispatch_opcode_7 boundary, whose default null value returns 0 instead of making the call; that substitution is a recorded limitation, not behavioural equivalence.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point data or instructions in the retail body or the candidate.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail never dereferences the path; it only forwards the pointer to the two callees. The candidate likewise performs no load through path and touches no struct offsets.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Loaded path returns 1 in both. Not-loaded path returns the callee EAX in retail (tail call) and the boundary result in the candidate; the two return sites and the zero result on the default boundary are present.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports int32_t(void* arg1) and Radare2 recovers cdecl with one stack argument; the candidate declares std::int32_t Resource_FileExists(const char* path). The pointer typing is ABI-identical and the int32_t return is preserved.

limitations: No paired retail/candidate game-process runtime capture exists for this address; runtime_tests and behavioral are intentionally absent and RUNTIME_TESTED/VERIFIED are not claimed.
The CFG agreement cited here is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image; cfg_similarity 1.0 is not a candidate-vs-retail CFG score, and the candidate machine CFG was not compared for isomorphism.
The candidate object was rebuilt and hashed, but the image was not linked by this review; no linked-image or receipt claim is made.

The dispatch callee 0x004B1FC0 is not transcribed. g_sys_dispatch_opcode_7 defaults to null, so the default candidate skips that tail call and returns 0 instead of the retail callee's result; the integration must install the boundary for behavioural reproduction.

The compiled object body is byte-for-byte identical to the 64-byte body recorded for source 655494c9... (symbol offset 0x20 in both objects), so the Qvm_ReportError edit provably did not change this function.

The binary_ninja and radare2 evidence signatures bound here were re-derived from the current artifacts (int32_t(void* arg1) and fcn.004b5b60 (int32_t arg_8h);); the manifest previously said 'not restated' and the artifact/gate comparison failed until they were re-bound.
